images.prompt: One blue enamel watering can beside a small terracotta pot holding a green fern on an off-white tabletop, simple side view with complete handles and spout visible. Photorealistic camera photograph of a fictional independently generated scene. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280 or larger. Natural material and light. No artwork, text, brands, logos, borders or watermark.

review.reason: The watering can and terracotta fern pot are recognizable photographic subjects; spout and both handle openings remain visible, with usable contrasting materials and coherent soft daylight.

images.actual_source_analysis: One large blue enamel watering can stands at right on a cream tabletop. Its long spout angles up left, with a perforated oval rose, a top loop handle and large side loop handle with clear openings. At left is one terracotta pot and saucer holding a leafy green fern. Soft daylight casts window shadows across the warm off-white wall and table. No text or people.
